propositions: Six uncovered src/rebar files are at or within 20 lines of the hard 800-LOC module-size cap, blocking any non-whitespace edits.
The CI module-size gate has no allowlist and the limit is locked, so raising the cap is not an option; files must be split along logical architectural boundaries.

Splits must follow existing call-graph seams between logical concerns, create no file under 100 LOC, and leave real headroom (target 720 LOC or lower) to prevent recreating the cap problem for the next contributor.
Existing tests must pass unmodified after each split, and any registry or import alias referring to moved symbols must be updated in the same change.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) became uncovered after in-flight work landed; the census is stale and must be re-measured before selecting extraction targets.
